messages:
ade: Heads-up: planning cross-region canary unpin for runtime v3.1 -> v3.2 in eu-west-1 at 14:00 UTC. Will touch model-routing and SDK pinlist. Deploybot will coordinate. Please ack if you have blocking work.

deploy-bot: [automated] Scheduled action: apply_unpin runtime v3.2 canary -> regions: eu-west-1. Window: 14:00-15:00 UTC. Runbook: /runs/unpin-canary-1743219876

maria: Quick note—llama3q-quant variants still fail older runtime due to kv cache layout. Did we include compatibility shim in v3.2?

sam: We shipped shim in 3.2.1 but 3.2.0 lacks it. Are we unpinning to 3.2.0 or 3.2.1?

ade: It's 3.2.0 as negotiated with infra. Hmm, that could be a problem. @kai @olivia any objections to switching target to 3.2.1?

kai: 3.2.1 has a kernel fix needed for quant workflows. I can cut a micropatch and coordinate a fast deploy, but it'll add ~30m. If we delay, we should scope eu-west-1 only & fallback to runtime v3.1 for requests hitting quant models.

olivia: For customer impact: only Dedicated customers using long-seq quant models are at risk. We can add a route override: `route policy: if model == llama3q and runtime >= 3.2.0 -> force runtime 3.1` until patch is live.

ade: Proposed plan: 1) Pause global unpin. 2) Proceed canary in eu-west-1 but target 3.2.1 (kai to cut patch). 3) Add route override for quant models as fallback. 4) If errors > 1% in 5m -> rollback to runtime 3.1. Agree?

maria: :+1: agree. Also add SDK pin note: clients on sdk-js <=2.7 have timeout mismatch with 3.2.x. We'll add an SDK gate: block canary for clients matching `sdk-js <= 2.7`.

ade: Good catch. @deploy-bot can you add SDK gate to the schedule? Also please attach a quick release note blurb.

deploy-bot: [automated] Updated schedule: canary target runtime v3.2.1 in eu-west-1; SDK gate: block sdk-js <= 2.7. Fallback route added for llama3q -> runtime 3.1. Rollback threshold: 1% error rate / 5m. Release note token: RN-1743219876

sre-bot: [alert] Runbook link: https://internal/runs/unpin-canary-1743219876

sam: I'll watch logs and KV cache traces. If I see `kvcache_mismatch` we'll trigger rollback immediately. Will also enable additional tracing for `kv_hits` and `kernel_compat`.

kai: Patch PR: https://git/repo/pulls/5123 ready, will merge on ACK. ETA 25m.

ade: ACK. Merge when ready. @olivia please confirm rollback playbook steps are in the runbook.

olivia: Confirmed. Rollback playbook step 2 is "re-pin runtime to 3.1 via deploybot --pin runtime=3.1 region=eu-west-1". I've added the exact command to the runbook.

maria: Noted. Also updating release notes: short blurb and compatibility table for models and sdk versions.

ade: Thanks team. We'll reconvene in #eng-runtime at 13:50 UTC for final go/no-go.

sam: Oncall: I'll be online 13:45-15:30.

deploy-bot: [automated] Thread closed for scheduling changes. Will post start/completion events when action runs.
